responsibility: Implements the FR-V target backend’s C-side logic and target hooks that complement frv.h/frv.md. This file owns the executable behavior for FR-V code generation decisions such as register and addressing helpers, calling convention and structure return handling, prologue/epilogue and stack-frame save/restore support, small-data section selection, assembler output for constructors/destructors and TLS/FDPIC relocations, RTX cost modeling, builtin registration and expansion for FR-V media/IO/prefetch/load-store intrinsics, and VLIW scheduling/packet repacking support built around DFA unit information and machine_function state; in short, it translates generic GCC requests and FR-V-specific builtins into target-specific RTL emission, diagnostics, and assembly forms.
same_name_distinction: C implementation file for the FR-V backend: unlike frv.h, it provides the executable target-hook code and helper routines; unlike frv.md, it does not define RTL instruction patterns and attributes but uses/generated them to emit and cost code, expand builtins, and handle prologue/epilogue, TLS, small-data, and VLIW repacking behavior; unlike frv.opt, it is not the declarative option table but the runtime logic driven by those options.
